div.p: Hourly labour assessment, labour summary, PPH diagnosis, newborn, postpartum and postnatal follow-up, and discharge.

Select a section. The other sections stay hidden until you select them. Values already entered are kept when you switch sections. Each save is one entry: record one hourly assessment or one follow-up per save.

Record one hourly assessment per save; the encounter date/time is the time of the assessment. Fields turn red when a value meets an alert threshold: alert the senior midwife or doctor and record the assessment and action in Shared decision-making. If labour extends beyond 12h, continue on a new LCG.
